channel.title: The Drill Down: Las Vegas Raiders
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Raiders at Browns
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CLE -4.5 · O/U 41.5 | Model CLE 73% vs. market 68% | Cleveland needs its short throws to the left, used on 36% of passes, to beat a Las Vegas defense that allows +0.21 EPA per throw there. Harold Fannin Jr. is the player to watch, since no receiver gets open like him and he faces a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 31st. Our model puts Cleveland at 73% against a market price of 68%, with the rushing matchup doing most of the work in that gap.

item.title: Week 11: Raiders at Broncos
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: DEN -10 · O/U 40.5 | Model DEN 80% vs. market 82% | The game likely turns on Las Vegas pass protection, which allows pressure on 23% of dropbacks, against a Denver rush that generates it on 25%. Jaylen Waddle, who creates 3.5 yards of separation, runs into a Raiders pass defense ranked 32nd, so Denver's receivers should find open lanes early. Our 80% Denver win probability runs close to the market's 82%, and the passing matchup supplies the largest share of that number.

item.title: Week 10: Seahawks at Raiders
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: SEA -6.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model LV 48% vs. market 28% | The game may turn on whether Las Vegas can finish drives, since the Raiders convert only 58% of red-zone trips against a Seattle defense that allows 67%, a bottom-tier mark. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the player to watch, drawing 35% of Seattle's targets and running into a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 32nd. Our model puts Seattle at 52%, far below the market's 72%, with the passing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Seahawks.
